title: Does the encoder-provenance signal survive content the model has never seen? Leave-one-family-out transfer at 4096 with 0003's fixed recipes: for each of the eight content families, fit on the other seven families' pool rows, score once on the held-out family's sealed evaluation rows, and read the stitched mixture against chance.

scope.one_line: One corpus (corpus A, data/pivot/full_c4096.npz, the 0003 corpus, not rebuilt), one seed (20260825), 0003's sealed evaluation set (260000 rows from 10000 held-out chunks) and 0003's 800000-row pool. Eight folds, one per content family: 0003's incumbent recipe (M1), 0003's logistic (L1) and the majority rule (U1) are each fitted on every pool row whose family is not the held-out one (about 700000 rows, in pool order) and scored once on the sealed set; the fold's reading is the accuracy on the held-out family's rows. The eight readings are stitched into the LOFO mixture: one accuracy over all 260000 evaluation rows, every row predicted by a model that never saw a row of its family. Verdict TRANSFERS if the model's LOFO mixture clears chance (0.038462) by 0.05; TRANSFER_FAILS otherwise; VOID on any validity or control failure.
scope.why_this_is_the_biggest_open_risk: Every number in this record - the curve (0003), the searched margins (0014), the boundaries (0007, 0011, 0012/0013) - trains and scores on the same eight content families. The grouped split and the null control rule out memorising source chunks; nothing rules out the model having learned eight family-specific encoder signatures rather than an encoder signature. A buyer's carves are not drawn from these eight families. If the signal does not transfer across families the headline is a statement about eight manufactured content types; if it does, it is a statement about DEFLATE.
scope.corpus: data/pivot/full_c4096.npz exactly as 0003 left it: 1300000 rows from 50000 source chunks 0..49999, 1108 features, carve 4096 by sealed cache identity (the cache carries no build metadata): y sha256 2b70426881e569f303c400b8dc2b3cb69f30dbe2e36a93dff56df54df9acf093, g sha256 eda31b7cfa24640dff694c00e62849537490c9572966a5247d1f5127800e4df9. A row's family is FAMILIES[chunk_id % 8] with FAMILIES = ["gutenberg", "base64", "binary", "code", "csv", "json", "log", "mixed"], the corpus builder's rule.
scope.seed: 20260825 throughout, as in 0003 and 0014; the split is grouped_split(y, g, 20260825, 0.2, 800000), 0003's, reproduced hash for hash before any fit.
scope.design: For each family f in the sealed order: training rows = the pool rows whose family is not f, in pool order, every one of them (fold_rows 'all'); no row of f and no chunk shared with the evaluation set, both measured and banked as counts that must be 0. Three fits per fold in the order majority, logistic, model, each scored once on the whole sealed evaluation set; the per-family accuracies are banked for every fold, and the fold's READING is its held-out family's accuracy. The LOFO mixture for a role is the accuracy over all 260000 evaluation rows where row i's correctness is taken from the fold that held out i's family; it is banked to 4 decimals and re-derived by the reader from the per-example vectors and the banked chunk ids. Two reproduction controls precede the folds: M1 and L1 refit on the full 800000-row pool must reproduce, within 0.005, 0003's banked 0.2395 for the incumbent and 0014's same-convention 0.1352 for the logistic (0003 banked 0.1392 for that recipe; 0014's refit of it on this exact block reached 0.1352 with lbfgs at its 400-iteration cap, so 0.1352 is what this machinery produces and 0.1392 is a drift reference the reader banks). A null control follows: M1 fitted on the first 20000 rows of the first fold's training rows with labels shuffled by the split's generator must score at or below chance + 0.02 on the sealed set.

scope.recipes_are_0003s: M1, L1 and U1 verbatim from 0014's sealed roster (params hashes in the reader): the incumbent HGB (learning rate 0.15, 63 leaves, 200 iterations with patience 10 on the last 10% of rows), LogisticRegression(max_iter=400) on raw features, DummyClassifier(most_frequent). Nothing is searched or selected; 0014 established that a symmetric search moves both sides, and a searched-recipe transfer is a separate preregistration.
scope.what_lofo_measures_and_does_not: It measures whether a model trained on seven content types identifies the encoder of an eighth. It does not measure transfer to content outside the corpus builder's eight families, to other carve sizes, or to other encoder sets; a pass says 'the signal is not family-specific among these eight', not 'the signal is universal'. The incompressible families (base64, binary, mixed) sit near the byte-identity collision ceiling in-distribution (0003: 0.1221, 0.1049, 0.1143) and are expected near chance under transfer too; the mixture bar counts them.

reference_0003_top_rung_per_family.note: in-distribution reference, banked by 0003 at the 800000-row rung on the same evaluation rows (artifacts/pivot/audit_rederivations.json per_family_top_rung_accuracy); the reader banks retention = LOFO / reference per family as an informational reading, never a clause

scope.cost: EXTRAPOLATION from 0014's banked confirmatory fits on this pool: M1 1428.4 s at 800000 rows, L1 679.6 s, majority 0.0 s. Each fold trains on about 700000 rows: about 1250 s for M1 and 600 s for L1, eight folds about 15000 s; the two reproductions about 2100 s; the null about 70 s; eleven gathers (two pool, one null, eight fold blocks) about 1 to 2 minutes each from a cold page cache. Typical total about 18000 s (5 h) of fit time; worst case about 70000 s (19 h) if no fold's early stopping fires, from 0014's banked M1 refit (1428.4 s for 33 iterations, about 43 s per iteration at 800000 rows, against the recipe's 200-iteration cap); no fit has a time cap. Memory (anonymous RSS, as 0014): a fold block 700000 x 1108 float64 is 6.2 GB, the evaluation block 1.15 GB, HGB adds a 0.78 GB binned copy and, before it, a 1.77 GB bin-mapper subsample that is freed before the binned array is allocated (the two do not coexist in sklearn 1.9.0), plus the boosting state: peak about 10 GB; the reproduction pool is 7.09 GB with the same additions, about 10.9 GB; the raw logistic scales nothing and copies nothing. Threshold 13.0 GB anonymous, launch precondition 12.0 GB MemAvailable, same limits as 0014. Every fit scores the sealed set, so NOT RUN is reachable only by a failed launch precondition or three launches without a new checkpoint before the first one exists.
scope.sealed_set_disclosure: This is the third preregistration scored on 0003's sealed evaluation set: 0003 scored it 12 times, 0006 for top-k, 0014 10 times plus 10 in a smoke confirm; 0015 adds 27 scorings (24 fold fits, 2 reproductions, 1 null), all of them fixed recipes with no selection, and its smoke runs add their own, counted in artifacts/pivot/engineering_log_0015.json.
scope.expected_outcome_stated_in_advance: Genuinely uncertain, and stated so. Prior: the structured families (csv, log, json, code) share byte-level statistics and should transfer partially; the three incompressible families sit near chance in-distribution and will under transfer; gutenberg is prose with no structured cousin. The mixture bar is 0.0885. A mixture near 0.09 is the modal expectation, so either verdict is live. A TRANSFER_FAILS does not revise 0003 or 0014; it bounds what they mean: an encoder signature learned per family, not across families.
scope.what_a_fail_would_mean_for_the_record: A TRANSFER_FAILS is filed as a boundary of the headline in VERDICT.md, README.md and every outbound document at full size: the curve and the searched margin stand as measured, and they are statements about eight content families, not about DEFLATE streams in general. No correction is owed, because no document claims transfer; the claim that would then be withdrawn is the implicit one.
scope.what_this_does_not_cover: Other carve sizes, searched recipes, content outside the eight families, the transfer arm of 0007/0011, calibration, or a buyer. Nothing here establishes a buyer, a customer, a user or a partner.

scope_parameters_sealed.passes_if: preregistration == '0015-lofo-4096'; smoke is False; stage == 'run'; the corpus block equals the sealed constants (carve 4096 by sealed cache identity, chunk size 32768, offset 0, chunk ids 0..49999, 50000 chunks, 1300000 rows, 1108 features, the y and g hashes); the banked protocol equals the sealed protocol key by key and hashes to the reader's PROTOCOL_SHA256; the banked recipes hash to the reader's RECIPES_SHA256; n_classes 26 and chance 0.038462.

sealed_sets.passes_if: The banked partition equals the sealed constants field by field: eval (260000 rows, 10000 chunks, idx and y hashes), pool (800000 rows, idx, y and sorted hashes), every fold's training and evaluation hashes and counts, and the null block's sorted hash.

no_leakage.passes_if: For every fold the banked counts train_rows_of_heldout_family, train_chunks_shared_with_eval and train_rows_in_eval are 0, and the fold's training index hash equals the sealed one (which was computed with the held-out family excluded); every fit record's fit_rows_sha256 and fit_rows_sorted_sha256 equal the fold's sealed hashes with n_fit_rows equal to the sealed count and the preregistered seed.

complete_one_scoring_per_fit.passes_if: complete is True; all 24 fold records, the 2 reproduction records and the null record have status 'fit' with finite top-1, non-gutenberg top-1 and eight finite per-family accuracies; every name has exactly one 'completed' event in the ledger; every fold record and reproduction record has a per-example vector of length 260000 in the scores file; each record's params hash equals the sealed hash of its recipe; the banked environment (threads 3, nice 10, sklearn 1.9.0, numpy 2.4.6) matches in every record.

reproduces_0003_fixed_recipes.passes_if: abs(incumbent_refit_top1 - 0.2395) <= 0.005 and abs(logistic_l1_refit_top1 - 0.1352) <= 0.005, each compared as round(abs(a - b), 6) <= 0.005 on accuracies banked to 4 decimals, for the two refits on the full 800000-row pool. The incumbent's anchor is 0003's banked 0.2395, which 0014 reproduced exactly under this convention. The logistic's anchor is 0014's same-convention refit of the same recipe on the same pool block, 0.1352 (LogisticRegression(max_iter=400), lbfgs at its iteration cap): that is the number this machinery produces, and anchoring on 0003's banked 0.1392 would leave an honest run 0.001 from a VOID on a control clause that has nothing to do with transfer. 0.1392 is banked beside the reading as a drift reference, not as the anchor. Failure is VOID: the run is not measuring 0003's pipeline.

null_control.passes_if: shuffled_label_accuracy <= chance_accuracy + 0.02, the control being M1 fitted on the sealed 20000-row null block with shuffled labels and scored on the sealed set.

mixture_arithmetic.passes_if: The reader recomputes each role's LOFO mixture from the eight fold per-example vectors and the banked evaluation chunk ids (family = FAMILIES[chunk % 8]) and requires the banked mixture_top1, mixture_top1_non_gutenberg, structured_four_top1 and per_family values to equal the recomputation at 4 decimals; the banked lofo_mixture_top1 must equal the model role's mixture.

transfer.passes_if: round(lofo_mixture_top1 - 0.038462, 6) >= 0.05 - 1e-9, i.e. the model's LOFO mixture accuracy is at least 0.088462 (banked to 4 decimals, so 0.0885 passes and 0.0884 fails). Verdict TRANSFERS if it passes, TRANSFER_FAILS if not. The same-protocol logistic and majority mixtures, the margin of the model over the logistic, the per-family readings, the structured-four reading and retention against 0003's in-distribution per-family accuracies are banked as readings and gate nothing.

arms: REPRODUCTION: M1 then L1 refit on the full 800000-row pool, scored once each on the sealed set; the incumbent must give 0.2395 and the logistic 0.1392 within 0.005.
NULL: M1 on the sealed 20000-row null block with shuffled labels, scored once; at or below chance + 0.02.

EIGHT FOLDS, in the sealed family order gutenberg, base64, binary, code, csv, json, log, mixed: majority, then logistic, then model, each fitted on every pool row of the other seven families and scored once on the sealed set. The reading is the held-out family's accuracy; the eight readings stitch into the LOFO mixture that the verdict is read from.
stop_rules: TRANSFER_FAILS is published at the same size as TRANSFERS would have been, as a boundary of the headline in every document that states the headline.

A validity or control failure is VOID: the clause is named, nothing is counted in either direction; a VOID run may be resumed from its checkpoints under the identical invocation and is never re-parameterised; a changed recipe, fold rule, rung or tolerance is a new preregistration with this one's VOID or NOT RUN on the record.

NOT RUN is reachable only before the first checkpoint and only by the three-launches-without-a-new-checkpoint rule; it is filed as artifacts/pivot/lofo_4096_not_run.json, the reader prints it and exits 2, and nothing is re-scoped to fewer folds or fewer roles. A failed launch precondition refuses to launch (exit 3) and leaves only the launch log on the record; it files nothing. A checkpoint lost from the checkpoint directory after its completion event is a terminal VOID for that fit (one scoring per fit, no refit): the runner files a NOT RUN marker and refuses to continue, and the reader, which reads the artifact whenever it exists, emits VOID naming the missing fits. The operator never runs git stash, git clean or any deletion against artifacts/pivot/lofo_4096_ckpt during the run.

Once any checkpoint exists the artifact exists at the sealed path with complete false and reads VOID naming the missing fits until every fit is banked; abandonment after that point is a published VOID, never a silent NOT RUN; every fit runs to completion with no time cap.

No recipe, fold or role is added, removed or re-parameterised after freeze: the recipes hash to a literal in the frozen reader and sit under the sealed scope; a record whose params hash is off-recipe is VOID; a fold whose training rows contain a held-out-family row or a chunk of the evaluation set is VOID.

The sealed evaluation set is scored exactly once per fit; no fold is re-fitted; interruptions are counted, never turned into a status; infeasible_memory is stamped only on a caught MemoryError or a kill whose last heartbeat anonymous RSS (RssAnon) was at or above 13.0 GB, and any infeasible_memory in this run is VOID (there is no model-side budget here: every fit is a reading).
The 0.05 bar is not lowered, the mixture is not re-weighted, no family is dropped from it, and absence, NaN or inf read as VOID.
This cannot revise 0003, 0006, 0007, 0011 or 0014; revises_0003_0014 and establishes_a_buyer are emitted False unconditionally; no customer, user, partner or buyer is claimed.

Cost is banked beside the result (fit seconds, ru_maxrss and heartbeat anonymous RSS per record, launches, interruptions, refills, the environment) and gates nothing in the reader; every cost figure in this preregistration is labelled EXTRAPOLATION with its basis.
The corpus, the evaluation set, the pool and the folds are one draw and are not redrawn; smoke runs write only to the scratchpad, are stamped smoke true, and read VOID.

thesis.what_would_make_it_fail_honestly: The model having learned eight family-specific signatures: a mixture near chance on every fold, including the structured ones, with the in-distribution per-family accuracies (0.29 to 0.39 on csv, log, json, code) collapsing to under 0.09 when the family is withheld.
thesis.what_a_pass_would_mean: That the encoder signature is shared across content types the model was not trained on: a statement about DEFLATE rather than about eight manufactured families, bounded by the eight families the corpus builder has.
thesis.what_neither_outcome_means: Neither names a buyer. Neither revises 0003 or 0014. Neither says anything about carve sizes other than 4096, about searched recipes, or about content outside the corpus builder's families.

invocation: export OMP_NUM_THREADS=3 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=3 MKL_NUM_THREADS=3; nice -n 10 python3 tools/pivot/run_lofo.py --stage run --prereg-file prereg/0015-lofo-4096.json --cache data/pivot/full_c4096.npz --workdir artifacts/pivot/lofo_4096_ckpt --out artifacts/pivot/lofo_4096.json --scores-out artifacts/pivot/lofo_4096_scores.json; then python3 tools/readers/lofo4096_verdict.py. Relaunching the identical command after a container restart is the whole recovery procedure; checkpoints are committed and pushed as they land.

smoke.invocation: The invocation above with --smoke added and --workdir, --out and --scores-out pointed under the session scratchpad; the runner refuses --smoke with any output path under artifacts/ and a real run with any output path outside it. The smoke block replaces top_rung, fold_rows, null_rows and launch; everything else is the sealed protocol.
